fixture: Passive ticks are paused. Fair arrivals supply 198 coins, trust is set to 45, and the clock is advanced to the named capture minutes. p04/p05 use display days 2/3. p06 uses day 8 at the board while the harm is in Weaver's lane. p01/p02/p03 and p08 use day 22, a Thursday with the arrival day's rotation. p07 uses day 43, a fresh Thursday with the same rotation. p09 uses day 5 at the Gate of Trust with the count seeded to 6 as in the master.
method: Real native Godot viewport. Viewport clicks drive fair arrivals, physical routes to market places, the move buttons and the return to the map.
